profile.headline: Principal Embedded Software Engineer  at Northrop Grumman
profile.summary:
I’m an engineer who’s passionate about solving real-world problems by blending mechanical systems, robotics, software, and AI/ML. For the past three years, I’ve had the privilege of working at Northrop Grumman, where I’ve grown both technically and personally. ive had hands-on opportunities to develop software tools, build standalone systems, and lead projects that push the boundaries of what engineering can do.

One of the most rewarding parts of my job has been delivering solutions that are both practical and impactful like packaging multi-script Python tools into user friendly applications. Whether it’s building a system from scratch or troubleshooting complex software challenges, I love taking ideas off the drawing board and turning them into working solutions.

With a master’s in robotics and a passion for AI and machine learning, I’m excited about the possibilities to shape the future. I’m actively looking for new opportunities in AI/ML, robotics, and software engineering roles where I can innovate, grow, and lead.

Outside of work, I’ve had the pleasure of serving as the financial chair for One Adelante, an employee resource group at Northrop where I help manage budgets, organize events, and build a sense of community. This role has been a meaningful way for me to grow my leadership skills and contribute to something bigger than myself.

I’m always open to meeting new people and exploring ways to make a positive impact through technology. If you’re working on something exciting or just want to connect, feel free to reach out, I’d love to chat!

positions.title: Executive Assistant/Labor
positions.description:
•	Operate machinery to facilitate and maximize efficiency of company services 
•	Carry out company services like renovations, demolitions, and excavations  
•	Responsible for producing and managing payrolls for 12 employees 
•	Ensure jobs were completed on the agreed date with the customer 
•	Demonstrate a gallery of prior work done to potential customers

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description:
•	Tutor students from elementary to high school in: Algebra, Pre-Calculus, Calculus, Chemistry, and Geometry
•	Track the progress of students by giving short quizzes at the end of each session 
•	Motivate and help students to improve in academics by showing them that mistakes aren’t bad but essential to learning.

projects.title: Truss Project
projects.description:
•	Designed and constructed a truss that could withstand between 500 and 2500 lb. of force among other design specifications
•	Individually cut all the wood into the required shape and dimensions, meeting specifications determined by the team
•	The finished product failed at 638 lb. of force due to shear stress (in the glue)

projects.title: Security System
projects.description:
•	Designed and built a mechatronics system using Arduino to perform sensing and actuation 
•	Successfully wired and coded the Arduino so different LED’s turned on and the speaker made sounds at different frequencies according to range of distance measured by the ultrasound
•	The servo operated properly by opening/closing a door according to the amount of light sensed by the photo resistor
•	Imported data from the Arduino using Processing to display various graphics when motion was detected at various ranges of distance as well as amount of light sensed
